## Goal

Improve error messages and handle edge cases gracefully.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Clear error when jj is not installed
- [ ] Clear error when not in a jj repository
- [ ] Handle non-existent bug IDs gracefully
- [ ] Warn if workspace has uncommitted changes during cleanup
- [ ] Better error context throughout

- 2026-01-13: Implemented all acceptance criteria:
  - Added clear error messages when jj is not installed with install instructions (work.rs, cleanup.rs, jj.rs)
  - Added clear error messages when not in a jj repository with setup guidance (work.rs, cleanup.rs)
  - Improved bug not found errors to suggest `docket list` (store.rs)
  - Verified uncommitted changes warning already existed in cleanup.rs
  - Added better error context for completed bugs, workspace creation failures, and docket init suggestions
  - All 51 tests pass
